summary: Frontend-only verification of the 4 drawing fixes (A reconnect race, B outbox dedupe/offline restyle, C outbox persisted to localStorage, D fib label clamp) plus the full regression matrix on /demo-trade. Backend (VPS) untouched. ALL 4 FIXES VERIFIED PASS. (A) offline create + offline delete + offline restyle -> reconnect: the offline-created rectangle STAYED in the chart and in the OBJECTS list (no vanishing), outbox flushed with acks then a single drawings/get; server ack already contained the new shape; frames show 1x save + 1x delete + 1x get on reconnect. (B) offline restyle preserved end-to-end: server row after reconnect is EXACTLY color #f43f5e, width 3, style dotted (verified with /app/tests/sio_drawings_dump.py); outbox showed a single deduped save entry per drawing id. Offline create + offline delete of the same shape left ONLY a drawings/delete in the outbox and the shape does NOT exist on the server after reconnect. (C) offline create+restyle then page reload: the queued write was read back from localStorage 'bfg_drawings_outbox:<accountId>' by the fresh page instance, flushed on the new connection and the row landed on the server with the exact style (#f43f5e / width 3). Note: Playwright route interception does not block WebSocket handshakes, so the socket connected right after reload - the persistence-across-reload path (ref initialised from localStorage) is still what delivered the write. (D) fib retracement pushed to the left edge (6x250px pan in idle mode, then 1m->5m): every level label (100.0% / 78.6% / 61.8% / 50.0% / 38.2% / 23.6% / 0.0%) is fully readable and starts right of the desktop tool rail (rail canvas-x 13..49, labels start at canvas-x ~57-95) - no rail occlusion, no canvas-edge clipping. REGRESSIONS: 2 shapes on EURUSD_OTC (after restyle+width+dash+move edits) + 1 on GBPUSD_OTC survived localStorage drawings-cache clear + reload byte-identical (ids/points/colour/width/style/visible), per-pair isolation intact, exactly ONE server row per shape after 4+ saves, delete + clear-all propagate to the server. Live cross-session sync with 2 contexts/same account/same pair: create, restyle, delete and clear-all all propagate in <3s without reload. Mobile 414x860: rail-drawing -> drawings-panel-mobile with 13 tools in a 2-col grid (x 12/209), tap-to-place works, style bar (y 506-652) does not overlap mobile-clock (y 60-96) or drawing-mode-chip, and the mobile-created drawing survived cache clear + reload. No console errors anywhere (only expected ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED WebSocket noise while deliberately offline). drawings/get emissions: exactly 1 per pair switch (3 switches -> 3 gets) - no runaway retries.

minor.issue: STILL OPEN by design (needs VPS deploy): unknown/empty symbol is accepted and answered with an empty list instead of an error ack. Not retested this run.

Server-side per-drawing write serialisation still absent, but the client-side outbox dedupe makes it unreachable from the UI - confirmed: no burst of same-id saves is ever emitted now (verified in the offline restyle flow, outbox held exactly 1 save per id).

issues: Level labels are plain text with no background chip, so where they cross candle bodies (e.g. the 100.0% label on 5m) the price digits are visually mixed with the candle colour. Cosmetic only, all labels legible and correctly clamped.

critical_code_review_comments: useDrawings.fetchList(): the retry loop still schedules up to 40 attempts (5s apart) for a pair - in practice only one get is emitted per switch (verified), but if the server ever stops acking, a page can emit 40 gets over ~3 minutes; consider capping at 3-5 tries with backoff.

useDrawings.onConnect() uses the `ws` captured by attach(); if wsRef.current is replaced without the effect re-running, the flush would emit on a stale socket. Low risk today (socket instance is stable) but worth reading wsRef.current inside onConnect.
Outbox flush emits every queued op regardless of symbol/age and has no size cap; a very long offline session could accumulate an unbounded localStorage queue.
TradeChart.jsx is still >700 lines (guideline) - the drawing wiring should move into a useChartDrawingUI hook.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 8 requested areas pass (4 fixes + persistence matrix + cross-session sync + mobile + no regressions)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway drawings on EURUSD_OTC / GBPUSD_OTC only. CLEANED UP: drawings/clear run on EURUSD_OTC, GBPUSD_OTC, USDJPY_OTC, EURAUD_OTC - all verified 0 rows server-side. One $1 UP demo trade placed as a regression check (balance 151.09 -> 150.09, Trades badge 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixes A-D from iteration_32 are all verified fixed; nothing left open on the client. Techniques used: page.context.set_offline(True/False) to drop the socket (only reliable way to force the offline path - Playwright route() does NOT intercept WebSocket handshakes); read state via localStorage['bfg_drawings_v1:<accountId>'] and the queue via localStorage['bfg_drawings_outbox:<accountId>']; accountId = JWT sub of bfg_token. Server truth via `python /app/tests/sio_drawings_dump.py [--clear] SYM...`. Panel gotchas unchanged: picking a tool closes the drawings panel; clicking desk-rail-drawing while open closes it - always check is_visible('drawings-panel-desktop'). Colour testids have no '#': draw-color-f43f5e. Asset tabs have no data-testid - use get_by_text('GBP/USD (OTC)'). Balance has no data-testid ('balance-amount' does not exist) - read the header text instead. For the fib label check: draw fib, exit drawing mode (drawing-mode-exit), close style bar + panel, then drag the chart left 6x250px and switch to 5m.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all four previously reported defects reproduce no longer. The ack-gated outbox flush before the refetch removes the read-before-write race, per-id dedupe keeps only the newest snapshot so offline restyles win, localStorage persistence carries the queue across reloads, and the measured-text + 60px rail allowance clamp keeps fib labels clear of the desktop rail.
